run_benchmark_from_flags: run benchmark_from_flags to get the benchmark name or Benchmark message from commandline flags
review_benchmark_from_flags: review the benchmark_from_flags function that parses absl flags to return a benchmark URI or Benchmark object
test_benchmark_from_flags: test benchmark_from_flags with a file:/// URI to verify it returns a Benchmark from file path
test_benchmark_from_flags_no_flag: test benchmark_from_flags with no benchmark flag set to verify it returns None
refactor_benchmark_from_flags: refactor benchmark_from_flags to support additional URI schemes beyond file:/// and benchmark://
